ayuda: Every cover with the same design: a clean frame from the clip, the title and your logo. Your profile looks consistent on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook.

DOS_COLORES.detalle: First line in white and the rest in your color, with an outline.

CAJA.detalle: Each line on a box in your color.

LIMPIO.detalle: All white, no outline, with a soft shadow.

sinLogo: Upload the brand logo above so it shows on the cover.

vista.ayuda: This is how it looks, on the brand's latest ready clip. Each post's title is the clip's hook, and you can change it when scheduling.

editor.textoAyuda: Empty: the first suggested title (or the hook). Enter for a new line.
editor.sinCuadros: This clip was exported before brand covers: the frame includes the clip's text. Export it again to pick from clean frames.
editor.otrosAyuda: Ask the AI for other titles

personalizar.ayuda: Opens the editor with the brand's design so you can change anything just for this post.
personalizar.propia: This post has its own cover: it won't change if you later change the brand's design.

disenoPropio.ayuda: The brand's standard cover, built in the editor: each clip's title and frame go in automatically.
disenoPropio.ayudaSimple: The frame, the title and the logo. With the editor you can build your own: texts, images, the person without background, shapes.
disenoPropio.confirmarSimple: Go back to the simple design? The brand's custom design will be deleted (posts with their own cover don't change).
disenoPropio.tituloEjemplo: This is how each clip's title looks

perfil.ayuda: The design on your latest ready clips, like the network's grid.
perfil.vacio: There are no ready clips to show yet.
